column1: BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 2 of the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007, I, Mahinda
Rajapaksa, Minister of  Finance, Economic and Policy Development of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka,
do  by  this  order  impose  in  respect  of  the  list  of    commodity  specified  in  Column  I  of  the  Schedule  hereto  a  Special
Commodity Levy, at the rate specified in the corresponding entry in Column II of that Schedule.
This Order shall be valid for a period of 31 days commencing from  December 14, 2019, subject to provisions of
Sub section (3) of Section 2 of the Special Commodity Levy Act,  No. 48 of   2007.
